BrochureContent.Content:
Blue Sky Property is delighted to present No. 5 Ard Na Greine, Lis Na Dara, Carrick Road, Dundalk, a superb five-bedroom detached family home in one of the town's most sought-after residential locations. No. 5 is located in a quiet enclave of detached residences, creating an ambiance of exclusivity. 
This home offers generous accommodation thoughtfully designed to combine well-proportioned living spaces with excellent outdoor areas, making it ideally suited to modern family life. 

On entering No. 5 you are welcomed into a large bright welcoming entrance hallway that exudes luxury and style from the get go. To the left is a sumptuous sitting room and to the right is the comfortable relaxing family room. To the rear of the property you have an expansive kitchen/dining/living room with direct access out to the south-facing sun terrace and private rear garden and a large utility room and guest wc. 

Upstairs, the property provides five well-proportioned bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with en-suite facilities, together with a family bathroom. The layout offers excellent flexibility for growing families, home working, guests or hobbies. 

Externally, the property is approached via a stylish cobble-lock driveway with landscaped front gardens and to the rear is a private, south-facing garden with a sun terrace, providing an attractive and peaceful setting for outdoor dining, relaxation and family activities. 

No. 5 Ard Na Greine represents a rare opportunity to acquire a spacious luxurious five-bedroom detached home in the highly sought-after Lis Na Dara development. The combination of generous accommodation, a south-facing rear garden and an exceptionally convenient Carrick Road location makes this an attractive choice for families seeking a quality home in Dundalk. For further information or to arrange a viewing, please contact Blue Sky Property on 042 93 33777. Guide Price: €565,000

Location: Lis Na Dara is an established and highly regarded residential development on Carrick Road, one of Dundalk's premier addresses for family homes. Comparable homes in the development and on Carrick Road are particularly valued for their generous layouts, modern family accommodation, private gardens and convenient access to local amenities. The property is within easy reach of Dundalk town centre, Clarke's Railway Station, local shops, cafés, restaurants, schools and sporting facilities. The location also provides convenient access to the M1 motorway, making it an excellent base for commuters travelling towards Dublin or Belfast. Lis Na Dara's appeal is further enhanced by its proximity to primary and secondary schools, medical services, recreation facilities and the wider amenities of Dundalk. The development's established setting and family-friendly environment have contributed to Carrick Road's reputation as one of the town's finest residential locations.
